parts.name: Pressing Lid
parts.Basic_description: The pressing lid is the top part of the dispenser, made of polypropylene plastic, designed to be pressed by hand.
parts.Functional_description: It acts as the actuator that dispenses liquid when pressed, controlling the flow through the pump mechanism.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns upward via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Head (Other)
parts.Basic_description: The head connects the pressing lid to the pump mechanism and outlet nozzle, made of durable plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It channels the liquid from the internal tube to the outlet spout when the lid is pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It remains mostly stationary but transfers motion from the pressing lid to the internal pump.

parts.name: Outlier
parts.Basic_description: The outlier is the narrow tube extending from the pump head into the liquid reservoir, made of polyethylene.
parts.Functional_description: It draws liquid from the base body up to the nozzle during dispensing.
parts.Movement_description: It remains fixed in place but allows fluid movement through its hollow interior.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The base body is the main container of the dispenser, made of transparent PET plastic.
parts.Functional_description: It stores the liquid to be dispensed and provides structural support for the pump assembly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and serves as the main reservoir for the liquid.
